mapper.sql: p.id, p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_subtitle, p.product_type_id, (select type_name from pt_product_type where id = p.product_type_id) as typeName, p.service_type, p.category_id, p.category_name, p.cover_url, p.product_intro, p.target_desc, p.original_price, p.sale_price, p.member_price, p.new_user_price, p.lesson_count, p.lesson_count_visible, p.duration_minutes, p.validity_days, p.refund_type, p.refund_rule, p.purchase_limit, p.sale_stock, p.sold_count, p.listing_at, p.booking_gap_minutes, p.booking_capacity, p.lesson_limit_period_days, p.daily_lesson_limit, p.latest_booking_hours, p.latest_free_cancel_hours, p.no_show_deduct, p.coach_confirm_required, p.sort_no, (select is_enabled from pt_installment_rule where product_id = p.id) as installmentEnabled, (select is_enabled from pt_product_group_benefit where product_id = p.id) as groupBenefitEnabled, (select gift_count from pt_product_group_benefit where product_id = p.id) as groupBenefitGiftCount, (select validity_days from pt_product_group_benefit where product_id = p.id) as groupBenefitValidityDays, (select group_concat(distinct coalesce(s.storeName, sa.storeName) order by sa.storeAddrId separator '、') from pt_product_store_rel r inner join store_address sa on sa.storeAddrId = r.store_id and sa.status = 1 inner join store s on s.storeId = sa.storeId and s.status = 1 where r.product_id = p.id) as storeNames
mapper.select: select , p.product_detail from pt_product p where p.id = #{value} and p.deleted = 0 and p.listing_status = 1 and (p.unlisting_at is null or p.unlisting_at > now())
select count(*) from pt_product p where
SELECT id, category_name AS categoryName FROM pt_product_category WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_no DESC, id ASC

SELECT sa.storeAddrId AS storeId, sa.storeId AS parentStoreId, COALESCE(s.storeName, sa.storeName) AS storeName, sa.storeAddrDetail AS storeAddress, sa.phone AS phone, s.hours AS businessHours, s.storeImgUrl AS storeImage FROM pt_product_store_rel r INNER JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = r.store_id AND sa.status = 1 INNER JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId AND s.status = 1 WHERE r.product_id = #{value} ORDER BY r.store_id ASC
